cohort: Pregnant women receiving either CenteringPregnancy or traditional prenatal care between 2018 and 2020, whose data was obtained from hospital birth records.
finding: CenteringPregnancy improved women's access to prenatal care and reduced rates of preterm birth and perinatal death, resulting in longer gestation periods and better infant birth weight outcomes compared to traditional prenatal care.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in delivery type (vaginal or C-section) between CenteringPregnancy participants and those receiving traditional prenatal care.
cross-section timing: Data collected from hospital birth records between 2018 and 2020.
birth_weight: Infant birth weight outcomes were measured.
